title: Votes and ratings in the reader-actions Lambda
description:
As a signed-in reader, I want to upvote, mark used-it and rate items on publication dimensions so that readers steer ranking.

Feature: Votes and ratings
  Scenario: Upvote is idempotent
    Given a reader who upvoted an item
    When they upvote it again
    Then there is still one vote
  Scenario: Revote overwrites, unvote deletes
  Scenario: Only published items can be voted on
  Scenario: Rate limit
    Given 120 actions in the last hour
    When the reader acts again
    Then the answer is 429 with retryAfter
